headline: Archipelago protects saves from the wrong seed; Difficulty fixes Blarg Station spawns
summary: Archipelago v2.1.0 remembers each memory-card slot's room and refuses a save from another seed, alongside logic and connection fixes (#24, #26). Difficulty v1.2.4 fixes missing ship and Clank spawns on Blarg Station by leaving room for the level's own objects (#34). Item Randomizer v1.0.4 was also released; all three releases were built against Mod SDK 1.11.0.
highlights: Archipelago's save protection was checked in the real game with two rooms: the correct room accepted its save and the other received no checks from it (#26).
At enemy count 2, Blarg Station's object pool now receives no enemy copies, preserving its own spawns (#34).
Issue #25 asks for play-testing of Archipelago and Item Randomizer access logic, including Trespasser checks on return Veldin, Aridia and Batalia.
The listing bot now rejects an unusable newest release, and releases explicitly trigger an index rebuild (#27, #32).
Listings state AI assistance per mod; publishing failures and recovery can alert maintainers (#21, #33).
Cross-region co-op, separate co-op saves and host takeover remain in draft #22, not ready for review or merge.
